title: Compliance Manager: Compliance gap triage
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: What permit evidence gap needs immediate authorized review?

answer.question: What permit evidence gap needs immediate authorized review?
answer.answer:
All 8 permits in the portfolio have critical, immediate gaps — each has missed its required renewal lead time versus days remaining:

- **PRM-8101 Air Quality** (Imperial Valley Solar) – 18 days left vs 90-day lead time
- **PRM-8102 Environmental** (Reno Wind Farm) – 22 days left vs 120-day lead time
- **PRM-8103 Water Use** (Phoenix Solar) – 26 days left vs 60-day lead time
- **PRM-8104 Hazmat** (Bakersfield Solar) – 28 days left vs 60-day lead time
- **PRM-8105 Avian Protection** (Tehachapi Wind) – 29 days left vs 90-day lead time
- **PRM-8106 Noise Variance** (Palm Springs Wind) – 29 days left vs 45-day lead time
- **PRM-8107 Grading** (Yuma Solar) – 29 days left vs 45-day lead time
- **PRM-8108 Fire Code** (Mojave Storage) – 29 days left vs 45-day lead time

**Most urgent: PRM-8101 (Imperial Valley Solar)** — only 18 days left against a 90-day lead time requirement, putting dust control, emissions inventory, and compliance reporting at risk.

This is triage evidence only — authorized permit staff need to validate obligations and approve remediation. I can pull up the renewal calendar or a prepared emergency renewal package next if useful.
